notes.title: 0.9.5 update released
notes.content:
[b]General:[/b]
[list]
[*] Offline support, game no longer requires active online connection
[*] Shooting mechanics for all gamemodes have been updated
[*] A new "game news and messages system" for latest developments and events
[*] The new Versus mode allows you to challenge other players’ high scores, with a defined skill level pool.
[*] 8 new achievements, 4 removed (goalie points and color block achievements)
[/list]

[b]Gamemodes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the position of Ball Cannon and Slapshot shooters to be slightly closer to the goal.
[*] In the Target Shoot gamemode, players can now change the target’s color and rotation speed.
[*] In the Onetimer Trio gamemode, you can now change passing speed 
[*] All breakaway mode scenarios have been updated.
[/list]

[b]UI:[/b]
[list]
[*] Redesigned the UI with improved visuals and navigation.
[*] Added several new UI sections (such beta info, leaderboards, news/messages)
[*] Redesigned settings page
[*] Redesigned the round start countdown intro
[*] Redesigned training, challenge and versus UI sections
[/list]

[b]Visuals:[/b]
[list]
[*] New glove textures for the "hand training gear", more closer to the soccer goalie gloves
[*] Added an option to enable/disable the 'shooter indicator' icon (which shows which player/bot currently has the puck/ball)
[*] Added an option to customize the ice surface color (indoor/outdoor).
[*] Added an option to customize the UI pointer color.
[*] Added an option to customize the puck/ball trails.
[*] Added new breakaway shooter models.
[*] Made minor adjustments to the Ball Cannon model.
[*] Updated the visuals for the “Shooter Indicator icon”
[*] Slightly slimmed-down color options for all gears, but now with a wider range of contrasting colors.
[/list]

[b]Audio:[/b]

[list]
[*] Updated the audio for UI elements and made small changes to other game audio.
[*] Fixed the issue where audio settings sometimes failed to load correctly upon game start.
[*] Option to enable or disable round start audio (instead updating volume due to previous mentioned issues)
[/list]

notes.title: Goalienator 1.0 SteamVR Beta Starting
notes.content:
Please only apply if you are an active player and willing to provide regular feedback. Please be aware that this is a beta test, which means that the game may have unstable builds, some features may be broken at any time, and we may remove existing features that do not meet our quality standards.

We have started rebuilding the game from ground up and are looking for active players to provide feedback as we progress with development.

[B]What is current status?[/b]
In Beta 5, we have been able to bring back most of the live version's features using a new codebase and visuals, with the exception of online features (teams and versus challenges).

[b]How to apply:[/b]
[list]
[*] Join our Discord server ([url=https://www.runbycoffee.com/discord]https://www.runbycoffee.com/discord[/url]) and express your interest in taking part in the test
[*] Or send email to contact@runbycoffee.com with subject "Goalienator SteamVR Beta Test"
[*] You will receive the 2024_Beta branch password upon beta approval.
[/list]
[b]How long will beta run for?[/b]
Start: February 16, 2024
End: June 30, 2024

[b]Why just not do public beta?[/b]
As we mentioned previously, we are looking for players who are willing to test the game and provide feedback/bug reports, not just 'play normally.

[b]Please note:[/b]
[list]
[*] There will broken, unfinished and buggy features we progress with development. 
[*] Your stats from the current version of Goalienator will not carry over.
[*] Your stats will not be saved and will be erased on a regular basis for testing purposes.
[*] You may be eligible for exclusive in-game rewards, such as equipment decals.
[/list]
We look forward to having you on the testing team! 

Links:
Discord server: [url=https://www.runbycoffee.com/discord]https://www.runbycoffee.com/discord[/url]

notes.title: 0.9.14.6 update available
notes.content:
- Fixed getting stuck on loading screen for new players, hopefully

- Updated "Options Page" layout and separated settings into categories:
* General
* Audio
* Visual
* Gear related

- Changed "Stick Position" option to "Stick Rotation" which allows to... rotate stick, shocking

- Goalie Points are back and working again

- Fixed players not being able to play versus challenges if they had won versus challenge before, caused by bug how data is being saved. Only affected Versus Challenges UI

- Fixed OneTimer Trio "Rank/Versus Challenge" to force"Glove and Blocker" gear kit instead allowing use currently selected gear set

- Fixed Color Block "Rank Challenge" not clearing data when saving "Versus Challenge" information, same bug might had been in other modes too

notes.title: 0.9.14 update available
notes.content:
[b] New Stuff [/b]
[list]
[*] New game mode "Soccer Cannon" for those who are motivated to test, under heavy work in progress
[*] "Gear  Position/rotation" settings page which includes settings for tweaking blocker position, glove rotation and goalie stick position
[*] Added support for bHaptics
[/list]
[b] Gamemode Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Onetimer Trio: Updated Drones positions and shooting directions.
[*] OneTimer Hockey: Player now shoots closer to blue line and updated shooting directions, higher chance of lower shots.
[/list]
[b] Versus Challenges [/b]
[list]
[*] Added "Color Block" and Hockey Slapshot" versus challenges
[*] Added "Play Again" button to replay current challenge
[*] Versus Challenges now selects 21 random challenges when clicking "filter challenges", this means all challenges are now available to play
[*] Personal highscore will be automatic saved as versus challenge, no need/option to press "save as versus challenge" anymore
[*] Updated Versus Challenge layout and "how to play" instructions
[/list]
[b] Fixes [/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed "Color Block" game mode stop counting "missed balls" after 10 missed balls.
[*] Color Block training/challenge mode no longer show secondary "goal marker" goal at the result screen
[*] Tried to fix achievements
[/list]
[b]Minor stuff [/b]
[list]
[*] Made tennis balls less bouncy
[*] Updated all shooting objects physics (tennis ball, puck) not bouncing so much
[*] Added missing haptic playback to UI elements which had none
[/list]
